title: Your Overview dashboard
description: A quick look around the home screen.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: This is your Overview dashboard. It pulls together what needs your attention across your portfolio.

steps.title: Search anything
steps.text: Find any tenant, property, or unit from here. Press Cmd+K (Ctrl+K on Windows) from anywhere.

steps.title: Create new
steps.text: Add a lease, tenant, payment, or task without leaving the page you're on.

steps.title: Things to do
steps.text: Past-due leases, expiring leases, open tasks, and vacant units, each one click away.

steps.title: Who owes what
steps.text: Tenants with an outstanding balance. Click a name to open their profile.

steps.title: Occupancy rate
steps.text: How many of your units are occupied, at a glance.

steps.title: Help & training
steps.text: Guides and training videos, whenever you get stuck.
